register_move_all_action_space: register a move-all action space configuration for the Habitat simulator
extend_habitat_sim_actions: extend HabitatSimActions with MOVE_BACKWARD, MOVE_LEFT, and MOVE_RIGHT actions
create_move_only_space_configuration: create a MoveOnlySpaceConfiguration class that defines forward, backward, left, right, and stop actions
get_action_space_dict: get the action space dictionary mapping HabitatSimActions to their ActionSpec and ActuationSpec
configure_forward_step_size: configure the FORWARD_STEP_SIZE parameter used for all movement actuation specs
